import itertools, time
from z3 import *
n=19
edge_pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n)]
E={p: Bool(f'e_{p[0]}_{p[1]}') for p in edge_pairs}
colors=[Int(f'c_{i}') for i in range(n)]
s=Solver()
s.set('timeout',55000)
for c in colors: s.add(c>=0,c<=2)
# color constraints edge => diff
for i,j in edge_pairs: s.add(Implies(E[(i,j)], colors[i]!=colors[j]))
# at least 28
s.add(PbGe([(E[p],1) for p in edge_pairs],28))
# no cycles length 3-6: enumerate subsets/permutations canonical cycles? add Not(all edges)
def evar(u,v):
    if u>v: u,v=v,u
    return E[(u,v)]
count=0
for k in range(3,7):
    # enumerate cycles as sets of k edges canonical: subset vertices, Hamilton cycles in subset starting min, second < last to avoid reverse
    for verts in itertools.combinations(range(n),k):
        start=verts[0]
        rest=verts[1:]
        for perm in itertools.permutations(rest):
            if perm[0] > perm[-1]:
                continue
            cyc=(start,)+perm
            s.add(Not(And([evar(cyc[t],cyc[(t+1)%k]) for t in range(k)])))
            count+=1
print('cycle constraints',count)
start=time.time()
r=s.check()
print('result',r,'time',time.time()-start)
if r==sat:
    m=s.model()
    edges=[p for p in edge_pairs if is_true(m.evaluate(E[p]))]
    cols=[m.evaluate(c).as_long() for c in colors]
    print(len(edges),edges)
    print(cols)
